SELECT E.CMPNY_CD, E.SITE_CD, E.SCH_CD, E.APPLY_DATE , E.FST_SCH_STR_TIME, E.FST_SCH_END_TIME , E.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME, E.SEC_SCH_END_TIME
, E.PRE_FIXED_OT_STR_TIME, E.PRE_FIXED_OT_END_TIME , E.FIXED_OT_STR_TIME, E.FIXED_OT_END_TIME FROM ( SELECT M.CMPNY_CD, M.SITE_CD, M.SCH_CD, M.APPLY_DATE , M.FST_SCH_STR_TIME, M.FST_SCH_END_TIME, M.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME, M.SEC_SCH_END_TIME , M.PRE_FIXED_OT_STR_TIME, M.PRE_FIXED_OT_END_TIME, M.FIXED_OT_STR_TIME, M.FIXED_OT_END_TIME , 2147483647 AS HIST_IDX FROM TB_SCH_MGMT M UNION ALL SELECT H.CMPNY_CD, H.SITE_CD, H.SCH_CD, H.APPLY_DATE , H.FST_SCH_STR_TIME, H.FST_SCH_END_TIME, H.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME, H.SEC_SCH_END_TIME , H.PRE_FIXED_OT_STR_TIME, H.PRE_FIXED_OT_END_TIME, H.FIXED_OT_STR_TIME, H.FIXED_OT_END_TIME , H.HIST_IDX FROM TB_SCH_MGMT_HIST H ) E WHERE E.HIST_IDX = ( SELECT MAX(E2.HIST_IDX) FROM ( SELECT M2.CMPNY_CD, M2.SITE_CD, M2.SCH_CD, M2.APPLY_DATE, 2147483647 AS HIST_IDX FROM TB_SCH_MGMT M2 UNION ALL SELECT H2.CMPNY_CD, H2.SITE_CD, H2.SCH_CD, H2.APPLY_DATE, H2.HIST_IDX FROM TB_SCH_MGMT_HIST H2 ) E2 WHERE E2.CMPNY_CD = E.CMPNY_CD AND E2.SITE_CD = E.SITE_CD AND E2.SCH_CD = E.SCH_CD AND E2.APPLY_DATE = E.APPLY_DATE )
SELECT M3.CMPNY_CD, M3.SITE_CD, M3.SCH_CD, M3.APPLY_DATE FROM TB_SCH_MGMT M3 UNION ALL SELECT H3.CMPNY_CD, H3.SITE_CD, H3.SCH_CD, H3.APPLY_DATE FROM TB_SCH_MGMT_HIST H3
